news.headline: Sebi issues final order against Axis Capital, imposes regulatory censure; Axis Bank shares fall over 1%
news.summary: SEBI has issued a regulatory censure against Axis Capital, concluding proceedings linked to September 2024 restrictions. The regulator noted no recorded investor harm or fraudulent default, while Axis Bank expects no material business impact.

news.headline: Global Market: Japan's Nikkei falls 3% as AI spending concerns hit chip stocks; BOJ holds rates
news.summary: Japanese shares fell sharply as concerns over the profitability of AI investments sparked a global technology sell-off. The Nikkei 225 dropped as much as 3%, led by steep losses in chip and AI-related stocks. Meanwhile, the Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 1.25% but signalled a hawkish stance, leaving the possibility of a future rate increase open.

news.headline: Reliance Industries Q2 results today: Can the old economy rescue the new Reliance?
news.summary: Reliance Industries is poised to reveal its Q2 earnings, with anticipation surrounding a notable profit revival in its oil-to-chemicals division. Analysts forecast a rise in consolidated EBITDA, supported by enhanced refining margins and solid petrochemical performance. Jio Platforms should offer consistent contributions, though Reliance Retail may face pressures with shrinking margins. Investors will keep a watchful eye on insights regarding future expansion in new energy ventures.

news.headline: Global Market: Bank of Japan achieves 2% inflation target after 13 years
news.summary: The Bank of Japan declared its long-standing 2% inflation target achieved after more than 13 years, but kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 1.25%. Persistent inflation, rising oil and semiconductor prices, and yen weakness have fuelled expectations of another rate hike in December as policymakers gradually tighten monetary policy.

news.headline: Global Market: ECB may pause rate hikes after December amid growth risks
news.summary: European Central Bank policymakers expect to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in December to counter energy-led inflation, before pausing further monetary tightening as rising bond yields are expected to weigh on economic growth and price pressures.

news.headline: ITC, RIL, HDFC Bank among top laggards as Nifty falls over 12% in 2026: Time to buy beaten-down stocks or wait for a recovery?
news.summary: In 2026, the Nifty 50 index faced significant drops, with 34 out of 50 stocks plummeting by as much as 34%. Analysts believe that the sell-off is driven by foreign institutional investor exits and a conservative outlook on earnings. This decline presents potential opportunities for long-term investors as valuations dip below historical norms.

news.headline: Jio Platforms share price up 28% from IPO price. Here’s what these 4 brokerages are saying
news.summary: Jio Platforms shares extended their post-listing rally, rising over 28% in three sessions. Nomura, Motilal Oswal, Dolat Capital and Elara Capital remain positive, citing tariff hikes, 5G monetisation, broadband expansion and digital services growth.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Share Price Live Updates: HDFC Bank's Price Movement Today
GAIL Q2 Results: Profit zooms 139% YoY to Rs 4,720 crore, revenue rises 33%; board approves GAIL Gas IPO
news.summary: GAIL (India) has revealed a whopping 139.3% surge in its consolidated net profit for the FY27 September quarter, showcasing impressive operational revenue growth of 32.7% year-on-year. The board has sanctioned the IPO listing of its subsidiary GAIL Gas Ltd. on Indian stock exchanges, facilitating a 25% equity dilution. In a strategic move, GAIL will also transition six city gas distribution networks to its subsidiary by January 1, 2027.

news.headline: Reliance Industries Q2 Results 2026 Live: Jio Platforms, RIL to announce Q2 results today. Brokerages expect strong numbers for RIL
Equitas SFB shares tumble 27% in 2 days on CEO exit. More pain ahead?
news.summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares plunged 27% in two sessions after CEO and founder PN Vasudevan announced his resignation over a perceived conflict involving his daughter’s NBFC.

news.headline: Q2 earnings upgrades hold above 50%, says Jefferies. Is the profit cycle turning?
news.summary: India’s Q2 FY27 earnings show signs of resilience, with Jefferies reporting that 50% of the 105 companies it tracks received FY27 earnings estimate upgrades, while 41% saw downgrades and 9% remained unchanged. The share of companies beating expectations rose to 56% from 52% in the previous quarter, though the recovery remains uneven across sectors.

news.headline: Q2 results impact: 2 Vedanta stocks rally up to 14% after Sept quarter earnings. How have they performed since demerger?
news.summary: Shares of Vedanta Power and Vedanta Oil and Gas rallied up to 14% after both demerged companies reported a sharp year-on-year improvement in Q2 FY27 earnings. Vedanta Power returned to profit, while Vedanta Oil and Gas reported higher revenue and EBITDA.

news.headline: BLS Polymers IPO allotment likely today; GMP hints at 45% listing gain. Here's how to check status
news.summary: The shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on November 3, 2026. A grey market premium (GMP) of Rs 68 suggests potential listing gains of about 45%, although this is not guaranteed. The company plans to use the proceeds for manufacturing expansion, working capital, and general corporate purposes.

news.headline: Maxwell Engineering, HGS India among 4 SME IPOs to open on October 30; issues to raise Rs 201 crore
news.summary: Four SME IPOs from Maxwell Engineering Solutions, HGS (India), Vectras Enprocon and Johnsoncab Electricals open for subscription on October 30, seeking to raise a combined Rs 201 crore. Here are the key details, including price bands, lot sizes and listing timelines.
